# The Siren's seven kinds as drawn at the shared base 8a5de43 (Tests/StationBaseline.cs wrote it; Tests/StationEnemyChecks compares).
# kindN.motion rewritten 2026-10-17 by the zombie motion pass (claude/zombie-motion, docs/ZOMBIE-MOTION.md): its secondary motion, strike curves and footwork change the seven kinds' posed joints and footholds on purpose (the facing is unchanged; each foot sets off on its own phase, a landing beyond the leg's reach is planted where the leg reached, the steps are planned under the balanced hips and the hips ease into a stride); every other line is the base's.
# kindN.takes, .give, .motion and .death rewritten 2026-10-19 by the locomotion pass (claude/zombie-locomotion, docs/ZOMBIE-LOCOMOTION.md): the kinds step at the body's cadence on new takes, their trunk and arms calmed, and the clavicles set in onto the chest, so the takes, the step spacing, the posed joints of the walk and the deaths change on purpose; every other line is unchanged.
# kindN.lookL.tongues and kindN.lookL.tierT rewritten 2026-10-19 by the zombie gore pass (claude/zombie-gore, docs/ZOMBIE-GORE.md): the Siren-era treatment is gone from the seven (no black-flame tongues; the seams are dead veins with no glow code, the crown cracks and armour strips dead, the acid and boils steady), so the tongue lists and the models' colour and emission sums change on purpose; geometry (triangles, vertices, positions, normals, bones) and every other line are unchanged.
